# requires: store
#
# Which records a sweep may adopt, as a function of state, lease and intent.
# Three of these rows cost something real: a transferred job re-fetched forever,
# a paused job restarted seconds after a person stopped it, and a job left
# RUNNING under a dead owner that nothing may ever claim again.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=file
submit B size=64 digest=good src=file
submit C size=64 digest=good src=file
orphans
claim A alpha 400
orphans
sleep 900
orphans
intent A pause
orphans
claim B beta 400
release B beta
intent B pause
sleep 900
orphans
claim C gamma 400
finish C gamma transferred
sleep 900
orphans
state A
state B
state C

# expect 4: ok A B C
# expect 6: ok B C
# expect 8: ok A B C
# expect 10: ok A B C [JOB-I12]
# expect 15: ok A C [JOB-I11] [JOB-T2]
